description:
Total cost of buying a robot vs renting it (lease / robots-as-a-service) vs hiring a service over a period, with break-even months and the cheapest option ("within_10_percent" = too close to call). Defaults come only from sourced price rows hand-tagged buy / rent / service for the job (each with source_url and as_of; pick another with buy_receipt / rent_receipt / service_receipt, or "none"); any number the buyer gives overrides the receipt. Running costs (upkeep, staff hours x wage, setup fee, resale) are the buyer's own and have no default. Same maths as whirrwork.com/tools/buy-rent-or-hire/. Without job, returns jobs_with_receipts. Not a quote, not a forecast.
Examples: {"job":"commercial-floor-scrubbing","months":36}; {"job":"crop-spraying-drone","months":24,"qty":300}; {"job":"commercial-floor-scrubbing","months":60,"upkeep":150,"hours":20,"wage":18}.

buy_receipt.description: Receipt index from receipts_available, or "none" to leave this option out

end.description: Which end of each published range to use (default low)

hours.description: Staff hours per month to run it (buy and rent)

job.description: Job (use case) id; omit to list jobs that have tagged receipts

language.description: Language for use-case text (machine-translated; English is authoritative). Default en.

qty.description: Service amount per month in the service receipt's unit (hectares, sq ft, visits...)

rent.description: Rent / RaaS per month (overrides the receipt)

rent_receipt.description: Receipt index from receipts_available, or "none" to leave this option out

resale.description: Resale value at the end when bought

service.description: Service price per unit (overrides the receipt)

service_receipt.description: Receipt index from receipts_available, or "none" to leave this option out

name: buy_rent_or_hire

options.description: buy / rent / service: totals, per month, source (receipt | yours) and the receipt used

title: Buy, rent or hire a robot service?
